note: Gameplay collision stays Codex-owned. This manifest states art intent only; positions/yaws come from placement.json. Local axes are Godot (X sideways, Y up, Z toward arrival = asset front).
floor: Keep the existing flat floor collider at y=0. ground_skin is a visual replacement (hide the old uniform floor mesh). Outside |x|>4.2 it rises up to 0.3 m of relief and, beyond 23 m from centre, up to ~2.5 m in the cliff berm, so no collision is required there; the crater bowl dips 0.32 m (visual only).

keep_clear.reason: primary travel corridor; nothing solid inside, both sides of the barrier open

cliff_a.proxy: one 0.6*W x 0.5*D x 0.9*H box centred on the module; rim only, players never reach it

cliff_shelf.proxy: single low box, top surface ~0.6*H; may be used as a step-up ledge

boulder_a.proxy: one convex hull from the mesh (<=64 points)

boulder_c.proxy: small; hull optional, hands may pass

geode_seam_a.proxy: body box 6.4x3.6 (Godot X x Y) x 4.4 Z at the rock only, exclude crystal spikes

geode_seam_b.proxy: body box 5.0 x 5.4 x 2.6, exclude crystal spikes

crystal_cluster_cyan.proxy: decor; crystals never collide so hands are not trapped. Natural crystal only.

crystal_spire.proxy: decor; backdrop skyline, outside playable area

meteor_fragment_large.proxy: hull of the main mass (radius ~2.1 m), impact-scarred rock

crater_rim.proxy: visual ring lip <=0.8 m; optional low ring of box proxies on the rim only, never in the bowl

mined_face.proxy: back mass box + 4 stepped benches as thin boxes; worked/quarried stone

observatory.proxy: plinth = 2 boxes (15x6.4x0.5, 12.6x5.4x0.9 top) with a walkable stair on the +Z front; drum = 8-12 thin box segments 0.7 m thick with the +Z doorway left open (1.9 m wide, 3.1 m high); dome ribs, telescope, colonnade stubs, crystals and rubble = NO collision. Sits behind the barrier centred (0,-26.2).

waystone.proxy: single box 0.7x2.2x0.7; worked stone marker at the corridor edge (|x|=4.7)

paving_a.proxy: visual flagstones <=0.09 m proud of the floor

deadpine.proxy: trunk capsule r=0.25 h=3.5 only; branches decor

material_classes.SF_Worked: cut / mined / ruin stone (pale ashlar, chisel marks)
